method: Original generative artwork made with the built-in image_gen tool for SearchScribe; optimized to WebP with Sharp.
resolution_note: The tool returned 1672x941 despite the requested 4K size. This web asset is not represented as native 4K. Repository product screenshots are captured separately at 3840x2160.
prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: an original editorial website image for SearchScribe, an open-source writing studio. Generate at the highest native quality, ideally 3840 x 2160 (4K), landscape 16:9. Primary request: a beautifully art-directed still life about turning a thought into a draft. A few large, sculptural folded sheets of warm off-white paper rise from a dark blue-green writing surface, a graphite pencil and one small metallic paperclip nearby. The paper folds create an elegant flowing landscape, with a single restrained ribbon of deep blue ink traversing one sheet, subtly suggesting a thought finding structure. Physical paper, believable fine fibers and precise folds; editorial photography, tactile rather than futuristic, refined independent design magazine art direction. Strong low directional afternoon light, long soft architectural shadows, warm cream and deep blue-green palette, subtle olive accent only. Wide cinematic composition with generous breathing room and a pleasing asymmetrical balance, beautifully composed edges, crisp material detail. No text, no letters, no logos, no interface, no screen mockups, no robots, no neon, no watermark. The existing SearchScribe logo will be retained separately. This image will sit beneath the hero, with a quiet slow motion effect; it should look excellent as a still.
